args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion. Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb. PHL is ambiguous: it also matches Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so the two need to be kept apart.

- Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows (Pellucid Harbor Logistics).
- Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments (Pellow Home Living).
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and should be relabelled to Pellow Home Living, so searches stop returning the old name.

Ask: please update the saved report label and confirm whether any other saved views or exports still use the Covey & Lark name.

Thanks,
Sofia Marchetti (drafted by assistant with Bettina Kroll)
